input: exact metadata-only artifact produced by the first successful v0.89 workflow execution
eligibility_principle: selection may use only list/checklist geography and coverage metadata returned under list_set_only=TRUE; no biological-response summary may affect inclusion
required_checks: metadata artifact SHA and workflow provenance are frozen
all selected rows remain geo_type Island under the original GIFT query
native and complete floristic/taxonomic filters are inherited unchanged
geographic entities have stable GIFT entity/list identifiers sufficient for later response routing
coordinates or polygon/area metadata needed for spatial blocking are present or can be obtained through a separately response-independent GIFT geography call
overlapping checklist geographies are not silently treated as independent islands

overlap_rule.reason: retain the full metadata universe so overlap handling is explicit rather than hidden inside the API
overlap_rule.later_action: construct an overlap graph from response-independent geography only; connected overlap components are indivisible validation units or one representative is selected by a deterministic metadata-only rule frozen before species access

block_rule.preferred: archipelago or non-overlapping geographic component when metadata supplies it
block_rule.fallback: response-independent spatial connected components from island centroids/polygons
block_rule.pilot_selection: deterministic SHA-ranked blocks after geometry is frozen
block_rule.heldout_source_exclusion: entire validation block removed before every species-conditioned source feature is computed

stop_conditions: stable response routing identifier is absent
independent validation blocks cannot be formed without species data
fewer than six confirmatory blocks remain after deterministic eligibility
